scoring_justification: Recompute the critical irradiance and structural trend from the raw power-vs-irradiance CSV against the paper's reported critical irradiance (2.3e6 W/m²) and thermoelectric share >37%.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden gold for critical irradiance (2.3e6 W/m²) and thermoelectric share threshold (0.37)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper abstract and Section 4.1.1: critical solar irradiance density 2.3×10⁶ W/m² and thermoelectric contributes more than 37% of total power.
hidden_assets.generation_method: direct extraction from paper text, not fabricated.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values the paper claims; used as reference for tolerance-based and threshold checks.

outputs.description: The hidden checker will locate the solar irradiance I0 that maximises P_total and compare it to the paper-reported critical irradiance; it will also verify that P_total increases before the peak and decreases after it, and that the thermoelectric device contributes more than 37% of total power at some irradiance.

output_contract.notes: The checker uses the CSV to compute the peak irradiance and verify structural trends. No gold values or tolerances are exposed publicly.

steps.description: Critical irradiance (I0 at max P_total) must be within 5% of 2.3e6 W/m^2
P_total must increase before the peak and decrease after the peak
At least one row must have P_TD/P_total > 0.37
